documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals reported strong consolidated financial results for Q2 FY27, with revenue growing 31.9% year-on-year to INR 1,342 crores and EBITDA more than doubling to INR 195 crores, driven by double-digit volume growth in the CDMO business. Management highlighted progress on key strategic initiatives including integration of Oriflame manufacturing plants, ongoing expansions at Baddi, and steady advancement in international regulated markets like Europe and Zambia. The company maintains a healthy balance sheet with cash and equivalents reaching INR 1,680 crores, while continuing efforts to turn around the API segment and maintain profitability in trade generics. Overall, the management remains confident in long-term value creation supported by healthy utilization and robust order visibility. Akums Drugs reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial performance, highlighting a 31.9% YoY growth in Q2 revenue to Rs 1,342 crore and a more than doubling of EBITDA to Rs 195 crore.

guidance.claim: The company expects the new plant at Baddi to fully operationalize by Q1 FY28.
guidance.quote: The plant will have oral solids in Phase 1 with an annual capacity of over 6 billion units, which will fully operationalize by Q1 FY28.

guidance.claim: Management expects commercial supplies for the European CDMO project to commence in FY28.
guidance.quote: Our European CDMO project is progressing as per our stated plans with supplies commencing in FY28.

guidance.claim: Commercial supplies for the Zambia JV from the Indian plant are scheduled during Q4 FY27.
guidance.quote: Our JV with the Zambia government is also progressing smoothly with commercial supplies from the Indian plant scheduled during Q4 FY27 and considering the prolonged shipping time to Zambia, we expect to book revenues during Q1 FY28.

guidance.claim: Management expects the domestic branded formulations segment to deliver growth on par with IPM by FY28.
guidance.quote: We expect the segment to deliver growth on par with IPM by FY28 as the current initiatives start bearing fruits.

guidance.claim: Management expects full year API losses to be lower than last year.
guidance.quote: We continue to focus on higher gross margin products and expect the full year losses to be lower than last year.

guidance.claim: Management expects operating margins to remain in the 14% to 15% range at an annual level.
guidance.quote: So we have always guided for a 14% to 15% margin.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates volume growth to be at least in double digits for the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: So for us, this has always been the key driver for our business and particularly over the last 1 year, this has been the key lever for our growth.

guidance.claim: Zambia order delivery is expected to reflect during the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Our API and trade generics segments performed in line with prior guidance with Zambia order to likely reflect during current financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the demand outlook for CDMO remains strong.
demand_outlook.quote: While the availability and the prices of input materials remain volatile, the demand outlook for CDMO remains strong.

demand_outlook.claim: The CDMO business achieved a volume growth of more than 20% on September net MAT basis.
demand_outlook.quote: Led by strong order book and improved utilization of newer facilities, the CDMO business achieved a volume growth of more than 20% on September net MAT basis showcasing increasing penetration of our offering within the India pharma market.

demand_outlook.claim: API prices have gone up 2% to 3% quarter-on-quarter and 5% to 7% compared to Q2 FY26 as a basket.
demand_outlook.quote: So API prices have gone up. If you really look at it quarter-on-quarter, these have moved roughly 2% to 3%. While if we compare it to last quarter 2 FY26, these would have moved up by 5% to 7% as a basket.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment for the CDMO segment remains robust.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment for CDMO remains robust and Akums continues to deepen its presence within the IPM.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the consistent performance of the CDMO segment showcases a healthy demand environment.
demand_outlook.quote: The consistent performance of CDMO showcases healthy demand environment as well as our clients' trust in Akums as the preferred manufacturing partners.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully integrated 2 manufacturing plants acquired from Oriflame during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we successfully integrated the 2 manufacturing plants acquired from Oriflame.

capex_expansion.claim: A new facility at Baddi will have oral solids in Phase 1 with an annual capacity of over 6 billion units.
capex_expansion.quote: The plant will have oral solids in Phase 1 with an annual capacity of over 6 billion units, which will fully operationalize by Q1 FY28.

capex_expansion.claim: H1 total capex made by the company was INR 210 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So for this quarter, as I mentioned, there is an investment of INR210 crores. H1 total is INR210 crores that we made.

capex_expansion.claim: The plant in Zambia is expected to become operational in 2029.
capex_expansion.quote: The plant is expected to become operational in 2029, expanding our manufacturing presence outside India.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced the acquisition of Oriflame India's manufacturing business covering two facilities and a leased warehouse.
capex_expansion.quote: On 23rd of July, we announced the acquisition of Oriflame India's manufacturing business.

capex_expansion.claim: Akums is setting up a new facility in Baddi to boost oral manufacturing capabilities.
capex_expansion.quote: So we are in the process of setting up one more facility in Baddi, which will go live in the -- almost at the end of this financial year itself, which will significantly boost our oral manufacturing capabilities, right?

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 14.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Margins were healthy at 14.5% as against 9.3% in Q2 FY26 and 15% in Q1 FY27.

margins_costs.claim: API EBITDA loss for the quarter stood at INR 5.7 crores.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA loss was slightly higher on this quarter, which is INR 5.7 crores while significantly lower than Q2 FY26 INR14 crores, however, higher than Q1 FY27 at INR3.9 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Trade generics segment remained EBITDA positive during the quarter with INR 1.2 crores.
margins_costs.quote: The trade generics segment remained EBITDA positive during the quarter with the third straight quarter of achieving profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Domestic branded formulations EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 24 crores.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR24 crores; a decline of 8.9% year-on-year, Q2 FY26 it was INR26 crores and an increase of 103% quarter-on-quarter, Q1 FY27 it was INR12 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 gross margin improved to 42.9% compared to 41.8% in Q2 FY26.
Employee expenses and other expenses benefited from operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: Other exp and employee exp benefitted from operating leverage

margins_costs.claim: Q2 EBITDA margin improved to 14.5% from 9.3% in Q2 FY26.
Operating EBITDA for the quarter increased by 35.4% year-on-year with margins improving by 238 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: The operating EBITDA for the quarter was INR175 crores, an increase of 35.4% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Margins in the domestic branded formulations segment were impacted by an increase in employee strength.
margins_costs.quote: Margins were impacted due to an increase in employee strength.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates at healthy utilization levels of above 50%.
orders_capacity.quote: We today operate at healthy utilization levels of above 50%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has 2 products approved in Europe, 8 filed and over 30 in R&D.
orders_capacity.quote: We have 2 products approved in Europe, 8 filed and over 30 in R&D, which we expect to commercialize over next 3-4 years.

orders_capacity.claim: Current peak utilization is already at around 50-odd percent.
orders_capacity.quote: We have already -- we are already at 50-odd percent, right?

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and cash equivalents stand at INR 1,680 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet continues to remain healthy and cash and cash equivalent as has been constantly increasing stands at INR1,680 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's balance sheet remains very healthy with a cash surplus of INR1,616 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with a cash surplus of INR1,616 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow for the company for the first quarter stood at INR65 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: The operating cash flow for the company for the quarter 1 stood at INR65 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that availability and prices of input materials remain volatile.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the availability and the prices of input materials remain volatile, the demand outlook for CDMO remains strong.

risks_headwinds.claim: Marketing segments, both domestic and exports, saw muted quarterly performances.
risks_headwinds.quote: Marketing segments, domestic as well as exports saw muted quarterly performances with multiple initiatives underway.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial supplies for the European CDMO project will commence in FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Our European CDMO project is progressing as per our stated plans with supplies commencing in FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial supplies for the Zambia JV from the Indian plant are scheduled during Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our JV with the Zambia government is also progressing smoothly with commercial supplies from the Indian plant scheduled during Q4 FY27 and considering the prolonged shipping time to Zambia, we expect to book revenues during Q1 FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The Baddi facility Phase 1 will fully operationalize by Q1 FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The plant will have oral solids in Phase 1 with an annual capacity of over 6 billion units, which will fully operationalize by Q1 FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the domestic branded segment to deliver growth on par with IPM by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the segment to deliver growth on par with IPM by FY28 as the current initiatives start bearing fruits.

management_commitments.claim: European products in R&D are expected to be commercialized over the next 3-4 years.
management_commitments.quote: We have 2 products approved in Europe, 8 filed and over 30 in R&D, which we expect to commercialize over next 3-4 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects improved performance from the domestic branded formulation segment from quarter 3 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: We expected improved performance from the segment from quarter 3 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Zambia order is expected to be delivered for this fiscal year, translating to roughly INR240 crores in revenue.
management_commitments.quote: Zambia is something we expect in the H2 that we deliver for this fiscal, the $25 million, which will roughly translate to almost INR240-odd crores in our revenue.

management_commitments.claim: The European business will be kickstarted within the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: And within the next financial year, we will kickstart our European business as well, which will -- so both of these businesses will uplift the corporate margins.

management_commitments.claim: The API business is targeted to reach monthly EBITDA positive status by the end of February or March.
management_commitments.quote: So the whole target is on a monthly level, at least by the end of February, March, we should be monthly EBITDA positive in this business.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
